review.observations: Grainy partial form rises and visibly resolves into a single lion head, mane and forelegs. Recognition strengthens progressively. Left side remains nearly black; no baked text. Lion stays right with believable photographic material and no sampled duplicate heads or extra limbs.
review.limitation: The initial grain mass already hints at a quadruped silhouette; not wholly empty at frame zero. Sampled visual review does not certify every frame or full-speed smoothness.
review.verdict: accepted for one broad cinematic insert; use whole5.167s so formation reads
